text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Heeey, you over there! Time for a good 
morning hug! Squeeze~!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, they CHEERED UP, didn't they! Now 
then, let's go help that downcast kid over 
there—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I see someone looking down in the 
morning, I give them some energy with a 
hug, YES!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to my day off yesterday, my energy 
is overflowing~!

It seemed Taiki Shuttle was able to rest 
even more leisurely than usual.
